notes.title: Developer Update Log: Deadrock Redemption v1.52
notes.content:
[b]Developer Update Log: Deadrock Redemption v1.52[/b]

Hello, players!

We're back with the v1.52 update for 'Deadrock Redemption'! Our team has been hard at work improving gameplay and fixing several key issues. Here’s what you can expect from the latest update:

### [b]What's New in v1.52:[/b]

🔨 [b]Updated Melee Fighting Components[/b]:
- We’ve updated all melee combat mechanics to work under **Unity_6000.0.25f1**. This update improves the overall responsiveness and fluidity of combat animations, making your battles more engaging than ever before!

⚔️ [b]Fixed Disabled Hit Colliders on Player and Enemies[/b]:
- The hit colliders on both players and enemies have been fixed. Now, you can expect consistent and accurate combat hit detection, ensuring that every strike lands as intended.

💥 [b]Attack Skills Damage Fix[/b]:
- We've resolved an issue where certain attack skills were not recording damage on successful hits. Now, when you land an attack, the damage will be properly recorded, making sure you get credit for those brutal hits!

🌄 [b]Added Far Collision Boundary Around Canyon[/b]:
- To prevent players from getting stuck in certain areas, we’ve added a far collision boundary around the canyon. This will keep you from slipping into unintended spots and allow for smoother navigation.

❤️ [b]HP Bars Refresh Fix[/b]:
- The HP bars of characters during fights will now correctly display each character’s health in real-time. No more confusion when tracking your health during those intense combat moments!

---

We hope you enjoy these improvements, and as always, thank you for your ongoing support of 'Deadrock Redemption'. We’re committed to enhancing your experience and look forward to bringing more updates your way.

Happy gaming, and we’ll see you out in the wilds of Deadrock!

- Entropy Digital Entertainment Development Team

notes.title: Developer Update Log - Deadrock Redemption v1.4.2
notes.content:
Hello, Deadrock Redemption players! 

We're back with another update to improve your experience in the wild west of Deadrock Redemption. Here’s what’s new in v1.4.2:

---

### Changelog:

🔧 Engine Update  
- Updated Project to Unity_6000.0.25f1 – We’ve updated the engine to enhance stability and performance across the game, ensuring smoother gameplay for all.

🎮 Bug Fixes & Improvements  
- Fixed Missing Hotspot Icons on Saved Restart – We’ve fixed an issue where the hotspot icons would sometimes fail to appear when restarting the game from a save. Hotspots should now always be visible when expected.
  
- Fixed Animation Glitch on Pickup Interactions – An animation glitch that would occur when interacting with pickups has been resolved. You should now experience smoother item pickups.

🌍 Gameplay & Controls  
- Added Camera Sensitivity and Placement Controls in Settings – Now you can adjust your camera settings to better suit your preferred playstyle. You can modify the camera rotation sensitivity from 0.1 to 7, with the default setting being 5.

- Default Camera Rotation Sensitivity Set to 5 – The camera rotation sensitivity has been standardized at **5**, but feel free to adjust it to your liking.

- Added Sound Effect to Accompany Character Jumps – A new sound effect has been added to make character jumps feel more impactful and immersive.

- Reduced "Inspect" Popups to Activate at 2 Meters – The “Inspect” popups now only trigger when the player is within **2 meters** of an interactable object, reducing distractions and improving gameplay flow.

🌊 World & Boundaries
- Added Far Collision Boundary Around Ocean to Prevent Leaving Play Area – To ensure that players stay within the intended playable area, we've added a collision boundary around the ocean. This will prevent players from accidentally leaving the world in that area.

---

As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. This update improves the game's usability and fixes key issues that should make your time in Deadrock Redemption even more enjoyable. We’re continuing to listen to your feedback and work on making Deadrock Redemption the best possible experience.

Happy adventuring, and we’ll see you in Deadrock!

- Entropy Digital Entertainment Development Team

notes.title: 🌵🤠 Deadrock Redemption Patch 1.2.4 Now Available! 🤠🌵
notes.content:
🌵🤠 **Deadrock Redemption Developer Update - Patch 1.2.4 Now Available!** 🤠🌵

Howdy, partners! We're pleased to announce the release of Patch 1.2.4 for Deadrock Redemption, aimed at fixing some pesky bugs reported by y'all in the community forum. Our team has been hard at work, and we reckon this patch will make your gameplay smoother than a tumbleweed in the desert.

🛠️ **Bug Fixes:**
1. Fixed the ending of the Doctors Orders Quest, ensuring that the finish animation sequence won't pop up before all quest tasks are completed. No more unfinished business, folks!
2. Removed the culling system from quest items, which could sometimes make certain items disappear from view. Now, everything you need will be right where it's supposed to be.
3. Bid farewell to the dress penetration issue! We've removed the renderer on Claire's legs to reduce any visible wardrobe mishaps.
4. Lowered the bitrate compression on all videos in the Alexis Animation sequence, as well as on the intro videos for all in-game characters. Now you can enjoy smoother playback without any pesky pixelation.

🙌 We want to extend a hearty thank you to all our dedicated players who alerted us to these bugs. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us make Deadrock Redemption the best it can be.

So saddle up and get ready to dive back into the action-packed world of Deadrock Redemption with Patch 1.2.4! Happy trails, partners! 🐎🔫

notes.title: 🌵 Developer Update: Patch v1.1.5 for Deadrock Redemption's Last Seen Quest
notes.content:
🌵 **Developer Update: Patch v1.1.5 for Deadrock Redemption's Last Seen Quest**

Howdy, cowpokes! We're back with some exciting news for all you gunslingers out there. We're rolling out a brand new patch, version 1.1.5, for the Last Seen quest in Deadrock Redemption. This update aims to address several bugs and improve the overall gameplay experience based on feedback from our dedicated community of players.

Here's what you can expect from the latest patch:

🔍 **Increased Bart Hotspot Indicator Range:** We've expanded the Bart Hotspot indicator range to make it easier for players to locate him in the game world.

🧳 **Fixed Lily Suitcase FX:** We've squashed a pesky bug related to the visual effects of Lily's suitcase.

🌵 **Increased Posse Member Hotspot Indicator Range:** Finding your posse members just got easier with an extended hotspot indicator range.

🏴‍☠️ **Added Delay to Player Control After Skull Pickup:** To prevent unwanted sliding, we've added a slight delay to player control after picking up a skull.

💀 **Fixed Skull Disappearance Bug:** Skulls will now properly disappear from the game world after being collected.

🪦 **Fixed Quest Item Graveyard Bones:** Rest assured, the graveyard bones will now appear as intended during the quest.

🎶 **Added SFX Music to CSI Wild West and Undertaker Complete Notifications:** Get ready to groove with some new tunes when completing these quests!

🏛️ **Moved Undertaker Quest Item Map:** We've relocated the undertaker quest item map from the center of town to the undertaker storefront for easier access.

🔨 **Fixed Hammer Quest Item FX:** The visual effects for the hammer quest item have been fixed for a smoother gameplay experience.

🎵 **Added Fade Out to Colt Theme Music:** Say goodbye to abrupt transitions with a new fade out feature for Colt's theme music during Bart's intro.

🌵 **Added Hotspot Indicator for Sheriff on Suitcase Task:** Keep an eye out for the sheriff with our new hotspot indicator.

🪦 **Added Mesh Collision to Grave Dirt:** You'll now encounter more realistic collisions with the grave dirt in the game world.

🗺️ **Fixed Quest Item Map FX:** We've ironed out the visual effects for quest item maps.

🎵 **Added SFX Music to Mindhunter Complete Notification:** Enjoy some new tunes when completing the Mindhunter quest.

🚀 **Limited Time 15% Launch Discount:** Don't miss out on your chance to experience the Wild West adventure of Deadrock Redemption! Purchase the game today for a limited time 15% launch discount.

notes.title: 🤠🌵🔫 Developer Update: Deadrock Redemption Patch Release! 🔫🌵🤠
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of a retail patch [b]v.1.1.2[/b] for Deadrock Redemption, addressing several bugs and enhancing your gaming experience. We greatly appreciate the valuable feedback from our dedicated community that has helped us identify and resolve these issues.

[h1]Here's what you can expect from the latest patch [b]v.1.1.2[/b]:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added 'J' Button Toggle Mapping to In-game Journal Screen: Now you can easily access the journal screen with just a press of the 'J' button, allowing for smoother navigation and quest tracking.

[*] Added Mesh Colliders to Rocks Without Collision: We've fixed an issue where certain rocks lacked collision, ensuring a more immersive gameplay experience as you traverse the rugged terrain of Deadrock.

[*] Fixed Mislabel in Thyme Quest Item: The mislabel in the Thyme quest item has been rectified to ensure accurate tracking and progression through the game's narrative.

[*] Added Colliders to Some Prop Furniture Objects: Certain prop furniture objects now have colliders, preventing unwanted clipping and improving the overall realism of interactions within the game world.

[*] Fixed Quest Items Not Appearing in Saved Games: Quest items will now consistently appear when loading a saved game, eliminating frustrating inconsistencies and allowing for smoother quest progression.

[*] Adjusted Hotspots for Offset Quest Items: We've moved some item hotspots that were previously offset from quest items, ensuring they align correctly for easier interaction and completion of objectives.

[*] Increased Hotspot Range on Multiple Quest Items: To alleviate frustration and streamline gameplay, we've expanded the hotspot range on several quest items, making them easier to locate and interact with.
[/list]

We're committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience, and this patch represents our ongoing dedication to improving Deadrock Redemption based on your feedback.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to embark on your epic adventure in Deadrock Redemption! For a limited time, we're offering a 15% launch discount on the game. Purchase today and immerse yourself in the thrilling world of Deadrock.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Happy gaming! 🤠🌵🔫

Sincerely,

The Deadrock Redemption Development Team
